sentences.zh: 于時議建明堂，多有同異。

translations.literal: At that time there was discussion about building the Bright Hall, and many held differing views.
translations.idiomatic: At that time there was discussion about building the Bright Hall, and many held differing views.

sentences.zh: 思伯上議曰：「按周禮考工記云：夏后氏世室，殷重屋，周明堂，皆五室。

translations.literal: Sibo submitted a memorial saying: "According to the Kaogong ji in the Rites of Zhou: the Hall of the Xia, the Double-eaved Hall of the Yin, and the Bright Hall of the Zhou all had five chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Sibo submitted a memorial saying: "According to the Kaogong ji in the Rites of Zhou: the Hall of the Xia, the Double-eaved Hall of the Yin, and the Bright Hall of the Zhou all had five chambers.

sentences.zh: 鄭注云：『此三者，或舉宗廟，或舉王寢，或舉明堂，互言之，以明其制同也。

translations.literal: Zheng's commentary says: 'These three sometimes refer to the ancestral temple, sometimes to the royal sleeping quarters, sometimes to the Bright Hall— they are mentioned interchangeably to show that their forms are the same.'
translations.idiomatic: Zheng's commentary says: 'These three sometimes refer to the ancestral temple, sometimes to the royal sleeping quarters, sometimes to the Bright Hall— they are mentioned interchangeably to show that their forms are the same.'

sentences.zh: 』若然，則夏殷之世已有明堂矣。

translations.literal: If so, then in the Xia and Yin eras the Bright Hall already existed.
translations.idiomatic: If so, then in the Xia and Yin eras the Bright Hall already existed.

sentences.zh: 唐虞以前，其事未聞。

translations.literal: Before the eras of Tang and Yu, the matter is not heard of.
translations.idiomatic: Before the eras of Tang and Yu, the matter is not heard of.

sentences.zh: 戴德禮記云：明堂凡九室，十二堂。

translations.literal: Dai De's Record of Ritual says: the Bright Hall had nine chambers in all and twelve halls.
translations.idiomatic: Dai De's Record of Ritual says: the Bright Hall had nine chambers in all and twelve halls.

sentences.zh: 蔡邕云：『明堂者，天子太廟，饗功養老，教學選士，皆於其中，九室十二堂。

translations.literal: Cai Yong says: 'The Bright Hall is the Son of Heaven's Grand Temple— feasting the meritorious, nurturing the aged, teaching and selecting scholars all take place within it, with nine chambers and twelve halls.'
translations.idiomatic: Cai Yong says: 'The Bright Hall is the Son of Heaven's Grand Temple— feasting the meritorious, nurturing the aged, teaching and selecting scholars all take place within it, with nine chambers and twelve halls.'

sentences.zh: 』按戴德撰記，世所不行。

translations.literal: According to Dai De's compilation, it was not practiced in the world.
translations.idiomatic: According to Dai De's compilation, it was not practiced in the world.

sentences.zh: 且九室十二堂，其於規制，恐難得厥衷。

translations.literal: Moreover, with nine chambers and twelve halls, as to their dimensions and design, I fear it would be hard to hit the mean.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, with nine chambers and twelve halls, as to their dimensions and design, I fear it would be hard to hit the mean.

sentences.zh: 周禮營國，左祖右社，明堂在國之陽，則非天子太廟明矣。

translations.literal: The Rites of Zhou on planning the capital places the ancestral temple on the left and the altar of soil and grain on the right; the Bright Hall is on the yang side of the capital— thus it is clearly not the Son of Heaven's Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou on planning the capital places the ancestral temple on the left and the altar of soil and grain on the right; the Bright Hall is on the yang side of the capital— thus it is clearly not the Son of Heaven's Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 然則禮記月令，四堂及太室皆謂之廟者，當以天子暫配享五帝故耳。

translations.literal: Yet in the Monthly Ordinances of the Record of Ritual, the four halls and the Grand Chamber are all called temples— this must be because the Son of Heaven temporarily matched and offered to the Five Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in the Monthly Ordinances of the Record of Ritual, the four halls and the Grand Chamber are all called temples— this must be because the Son of Heaven temporarily matched and offered to the Five Emperors.

sentences.zh: 又王制云：『周人養國老於東膠。

translations.literal: Moreover the Royal Regulations say: 'The Zhou people nurtured the state's elders at the Eastern Academy.'
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Royal Regulations say: 'The Zhou people nurtured the state's elders at the Eastern Academy.'

sentences.zh: 』鄭注云：東膠即辟雍，在王宮之東。

translations.literal: Zheng's commentary says: the Eastern Academy is the Piyong, east of the royal palace.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng's commentary says: the Eastern Academy is the Piyong, east of the royal palace.

sentences.zh: 又詩大雅云：『邕邕在宮，肅肅在廟。

translations.literal: Moreover the Da Ya in the Book of Poetry says: 'Harmonious in the palace, solemn in the temple.'
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Da Ya in the Book of Poetry says: 'Harmonious in the palace, solemn in the temple.'

sentences.zh: 』鄭注云：『宮，謂辟雍宮也，所以助王。

translations.literal: Zheng's commentary says: 'The palace means the Piyong palace, which assists the king.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng's commentary says: 'The palace means the Piyong palace, which assists the king.

sentences.zh: 養老則尚和，助祭則尚敬。

translations.literal: In nurturing the aged one values harmony; in assisting sacrifice one values reverence.'
translations.idiomatic: In nurturing the aged one values harmony; in assisting sacrifice one values reverence.'

sentences.zh: 』又不在明堂之驗矣。

translations.literal: This too is not verified in the Bright Hall.'
translations.idiomatic: This too is not verified in the Bright Hall.'

sentences.zh: 按孟子云：『齊宣王謂孟子曰，吾欲毀明堂。

translations.literal: According to Mencius: 'King Xuan of Qi said to Mencius, I wish to destroy the Bright Hall.'
translations.idiomatic: According to Mencius: 'King Xuan of Qi said to Mencius, I wish to destroy the Bright Hall.'

sentences.zh: 』若明堂是廟，則不應有毀之問。

translations.literal: If the Bright Hall were a temple, there should not have been a question about destroying it.
translations.idiomatic: If the Bright Hall were a temple, there should not have been a question about destroying it.

sentences.zh: 且蔡邕論明堂之制云：『堂方一百四十尺，象坤之策；

translations.literal: Moreover Cai Yong's discussion of the Bright Hall's design says: 'The hall is one hundred forty chi square, matching the earth's tally;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Cai Yong's discussion of the Bright Hall's design says: 'The hall is one hundred forty chi square, matching the earth's tally;

sentences.zh: 屋圓徑二百一十六尺，象乾之策；

translations.literal: the roof is two hundred sixteen chi in diameter, matching heaven's tally;
translations.idiomatic: the roof is two hundred sixteen chi in diameter, matching heaven's tally;

sentences.zh: 方六丈，徑九丈，象陽陰九六之數；

translations.literal: six zhang square, nine zhang in diameter, matching the numbers of yin and yang, nine and six;
translations.idiomatic: six zhang square, nine zhang in diameter, matching the numbers of yin and yang, nine and six;

sentences.zh: 九室以象九州；

translations.literal: nine chambers to represent the Nine Provinces;
translations.idiomatic: nine chambers to represent the Nine Provinces;

sentences.zh: 屋高八十一尺，象黃鍾九九之數；

translations.literal: the roof eighty-one chi high, matching the nine nines of the Yellow Bell;
translations.idiomatic: the roof eighty-one chi high, matching the nine nines of the Yellow Bell;

sentences.zh: 二十八柱以象宿；

translations.literal: twenty-eight pillars to represent the lodges;
translations.idiomatic: twenty-eight pillars to represent the lodges;

sentences.zh: 外廣二十四丈以象氣。

translations.literal: the outer width twenty-four zhang to represent the qi.'
translations.idiomatic: the outer width twenty-four zhang to represent the qi.'

sentences.zh: 』按此皆以天地陰陽氣數為法，而室獨象九州，何也？

translations.literal: According to this, all take heaven, earth, yin, yang, and numerical qi as their model— yet the chambers alone represent the Nine Provinces. Why?
translations.idiomatic: According to this, all take heaven, earth, yin, yang, and numerical qi as their model— yet the chambers alone represent the Nine Provinces. Why?

sentences.zh: 若立五室以象五行，豈不快也？

translations.literal: If one established five chambers to represent the Five Phases, would that not be fitting?
translations.idiomatic: If one established five chambers to represent the Five Phases, would that not be fitting?

sentences.zh: 如此，蔡氏之論非為通典，九室之言或未可從。

translations.literal: Thus Cai's discussion is not a universal standard, and the words about nine chambers perhaps should not be followed.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Cai's discussion is not a universal standard, and the words about nine chambers perhaps should not be followed.

sentences.zh: 竊尋考工記雖是補闕之書，相承已久，諸儒注述無言非者，方之後作，不亦優乎？

translations.literal: I privately consider that although the Kaogong ji is a supplementary text, it has been transmitted for a long time, and none of the Confucian commentators who annotated it speak against it— compared with later works, is it not superior?
translations.idiomatic: I privately consider that although the Kaogong ji is a supplementary text, it has been transmitted for a long time, and none of the Confucian commentators who annotated it speak against it— compared with later works, is it not superior?

sentences.zh: 且孝經援神契、五經要義、舊禮圖，皆作五室，及徐劉之論，同考工者多矣。

translations.literal: Moreover the Classic of Filial Piety's Yuan Shen Qi, the Essentials of the Five Classics, and the Old Ritual Diagram all have five chambers; Xu and Liu's discussions, like the Kaogong ji, are many.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Classic of Filial Piety's Yuan Shen Qi, the Essentials of the Five Classics, and the Old Ritual Diagram all have five chambers; Xu and Liu's discussions, like the Kaogong ji, are many.

sentences.zh: 朝廷若獨絕今古，自為一代制作者，則所願也。

translations.literal: If the court alone breaks with past and present and creates institutions for a single age, that is what I wish.
translations.idiomatic: If the court alone breaks with past and present and creates institutions for a single age, that is what I wish.

sentences.zh: 若猶祖述舊章，規摹前事，不應捨殷周成法，襲近代妄作。

translations.literal: If it still follows old statutes and models former affairs, it should not abandon the established methods of Yin and Zhou and adopt the reckless works of recent times.
translations.idiomatic: If it still follows old statutes and models former affairs, it should not abandon the established methods of Yin and Zhou and adopt the reckless works of recent times.

sentences.zh: 且損益之極，極於三王，後來疑議，難可準信。

translations.literal: Moreover the limit of increase and decrease reaches its extreme with the Three Kings; later doubtful disputes can hardly serve as reliable standards.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the limit of increase and decrease reaches its extreme with the Three Kings; later doubtful disputes can hardly serve as reliable standards.

sentences.zh: 鄭玄云：『周人明堂五室，是帝各有一室也，合於五行之數，周禮依數以為之室。

translations.literal: Zheng Xuan says: 'The Zhou people's Bright Hall had five chambers— each emperor had one chamber, matching the number of the Five Phases; the Rites of Zhou made chambers according to the numbers.'
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan says: 'The Zhou people's Bright Hall had five chambers— each emperor had one chamber, matching the number of the Five Phases; the Rites of Zhou made chambers according to the numbers.'

sentences.zh: 施行于今，雖有不同，時說然耳。

translations.literal: Applied down to the present, though there are differences, contemporary explanations are still valid.
translations.idiomatic: Applied down to the present, though there are differences, contemporary explanations are still valid.'

sentences.zh: 』尋鄭此論，非為無當。

translations.literal: Examining Zheng's discussion, it is not without merit.
translations.idiomatic: Examining Zheng's discussion, it is not without merit.

sentences.zh: 按月令亦無九室之文，原其制置，不乖五室。

translations.literal: According to the Monthly Ordinances there is also no text about nine chambers; tracing its arrangement, it does not contradict five chambers.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Monthly Ordinances there is also no text about nine chambers; tracing its arrangement, it does not contradict five chambers.

sentences.zh: 其青陽右个即明堂左个，明堂右个即總章左个，總章右个即玄堂左个，玄堂右个即青陽左个。

translations.literal: The Green Yang right wing is the Bright Hall left wing; the Bright Hall right wing is the Zongzhang left wing; the Zongzhang right wing is the Xuantang left wing; the Xuantang right wing is the Green Yang left wing.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Yang right wing is the Bright Hall left wing; the Bright Hall right wing is the Zongzhang left wing; the Zongzhang right wing is the Xuantang left wing; the Xuantang right wing is the Green Yang left wing.

sentences.zh: 如此，則室猶是五，而布政十二。

translations.literal: Thus the chambers are still five, while governance is distributed in twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the chambers are still five, while governance is distributed in twelve.

sentences.zh: 五室之理，謂為可安。

translations.literal: The principle of five chambers may be considered secure.
translations.idiomatic: The principle of five chambers may be considered secure.

sentences.zh: 其方圓高廣，自依時量。

translations.literal: As to square, round, height, and breadth, let them follow the measures of the time.
translations.idiomatic: As to square, round, height, and breadth, let them follow the measures of the time.

sentences.zh: 戴氏九室之言，蔡子廟學之議，子幹靈臺之說，裴逸一屋之論，及諸家紛紜，並無取焉。

translations.literal: Dai's words about nine chambers, Cai's discussion of temple learning, Zigan's talk of the Spirit Terrace, Pei Yi's theory of a single hall, and the various schools' disputes— none are to be adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Dai's words about nine chambers, Cai's discussion of temple learning, Zigan's talk of the Spirit Terrace, Pei Yi's theory of a single hall, and the various schools' disputes— none are to be adopted.

sentences.zh: 」學者善其議。

translations.literal: Scholars approved his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars approved his memorial.

sentences.zh: 又遷太常卿，兼度支尚書，轉正都官。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Director of the Court of Ceremonies, concurrently Minister of Revenue, then transferred to Director of the Capital Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to Director of the Court of Ceremonies, concurrently Minister of Revenue, then transferred to Director of the Capital Censorate.

sentences.zh: 時太保崔光疾甚，表薦思伯為侍講，中書舍人馮元興為侍讀。

translations.literal: At that time Grand Tutor Cui Guang was gravely ill and submitted a memorial recommending Sibo as Lecturer and Palace Library Attendant Feng Yuanxing as Reader.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Grand Tutor Cui Guang was gravely ill and submitted a memorial recommending Sibo as Lecturer and Palace Library Attendant Feng Yuanxing as Reader.

sentences.zh: 思伯遂入授肅宗杜氏春秋。

translations.literal: Sibo thereupon entered to instruct Emperor Suzong in the Du clan Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: Sibo thereupon entered to instruct Emperor Xiaoming in the Du clan Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 思伯少雖明經，從官廢業，至是更延儒生夜講晝授。

translations.literal: Though Sibo had mastered the classics in youth, official service had interrupted his studies; at this time he again invited Confucian scholars to lecture at night and teach by day.
translations.idiomatic: Though Sibo had mastered the classics in youth, official service had interrupted his studies; at this time he again invited Confucian scholars to lecture at night and teach by day.

sentences.zh: 性謙和，傾身禮士，雖在街途，停車下馬，接誘恂恂，曾無倦色。

translations.literal: By nature he was modest and harmonious, bowing his body to honor scholars; even on the street he would stop his carriage and dismount, receiving and guiding people with earnest courtesy, never showing weariness.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was modest and harmonious, bowing his body to honor scholars; even on the street he would stop his carriage and dismount, receiving and guiding people with earnest courtesy, never showing weariness.

sentences.zh: 客有謂思伯曰：「公今貴重，寧能不驕？

translations.literal: A guest said to Sibo: "You are now noble and honored— can you not be proud?
translations.idiomatic: A guest said to Sibo: "You are now noble and honored— can you not be proud?"

sentences.zh: 」思伯曰：「衰至便驕，何常之有？

translations.literal: Sibo said: "When decline arrives one becomes proud— what constancy is there in that?
translations.idiomatic: Sibo said: "When decline arrives one becomes proud— what constancy is there in that?"

sentences.zh: 」當世以為雅談。

translations.literal: People of the time regarded this as refined talk.
translations.idiomatic: People of the time regarded this as refined talk.

sentences.zh: 為元叉所寵，論者譏其趣勢。

translations.literal: He was favored by Yuan Cha; commentators ridiculed him for courting power.
translations.idiomatic: He was favored by Yuan Cha; commentators ridiculed him for courting power.

sentences.zh: 孝昌元年卒。

translations.literal: He died in the first year of Xiaochang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Xiaochang.

sentences.zh: 贈鎮東將軍、青州刺史，又贈尚書右僕射，諡曰文貞。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded General Who Pacifies the East and Inspector of Qingzhou, and again awarded Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, with the posthumous title Wenzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded General Who Pacifies the East and Inspector of Qingzhou, and again awarded Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, with the posthumous title Wenzhen.

sentences.zh: 子彥始，武定中，淮陽太守。

translations.literal: His son Yan Shi, during the Wuding era, served as Administrator of Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yan Shi, during the Wuding era, served as Administrator of Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 思伯弟思同，字士明。

translations.literal: Sibo's younger brother Sitong, styled Shiming.
translations.idiomatic: Sibo's younger brother Sitong, styled Shiming.

sentences.zh: 少厲志行，雅好經史。

translations.literal: From youth he cultivated will and conduct and dearly loved the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he cultivated will and conduct and dearly loved the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 釋褐彭城王國侍郎，五遷尚書考功郎，青州別駕。

translations.literal: He began his career as Gentleman of the Prince of Pengcheng's kingdom, was promoted five times to Reviewing Officer in the Ministry of Works, and served as Vice Prefect of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He began his career as Gentleman of the Prince of Pengcheng's kingdom, was promoted five times to Reviewing Officer in the Ministry of Works, and served as Vice Prefect of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，遷鎮遠將軍、中散大夫、試守滎陽太守。

translations.literal: After a long time he was transferred to General Who Pacifies the Distance, Regular Grand Master of the Palace, and provisional Administrator of Xingyang.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was transferred to General Who Pacifies the Distance, Regular Grand Master of the Palace, and provisional Administrator of Xingyang.

sentences.zh: 尋即真。

translations.literal: Soon he received full appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he received full appointment.

sentences.zh: 後除平南將軍、襄州刺史。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 雖無明察之譽，百姓安之。

translations.literal: Though he had no reputation for sharp discernment, the common people were at peace under him.
translations.idiomatic: Though he had no reputation for sharp discernment, the common people were at peace under him.

sentences.zh: 及元顥之亂也，思同與廣州刺史鄭先護並不降。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao's rebellion occurred, Sitong and Administrator of Guangzhou Zheng Xianhu both refused to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao's rebellion occurred, Sitong and Administrator of Guangzhou Zheng Xianhu both refused to surrender.

sentences.zh: 莊帝還宮，封營陵縣開國男，邑二百戶，除撫軍將軍、給事黃門侍郎、青州大中正。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhuang returned to the palace, Sitong was enfeoffed as Baron of Yingling with a fief of two hundred households, and appointed General Who Pacifies the Army, Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat in the Affairs Section, and Chief Rectifier of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozhuang returned to the palace, Sitong was enfeoffed as Baron of Yingling with a fief of two hundred households, and appointed General Who Pacifies the Army, Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat in the Affairs Section, and Chief Rectifier of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 又為鎮東、金紫光祿大夫，仍兼黃門。

translations.literal: He again served as General Who Pacifies the East and Grand Master of the Palace with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, still concurrently in the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as General Who Pacifies the East and Grand Master of the Palace with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, still concurrently in the Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 尋加車騎大將軍、左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Soon he was additionally appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Grand Master of the Palace with Left Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was additionally appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Grand Master of the Palace with Left Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 遷鄴後，除黃門侍郎、兼侍中、河南慰勞大使。

translations.literal: After the transfer to Ye, he was appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, concurrently Palace Attendant, and Commissioner to Console Henan.
translations.idiomatic: After the transfer to Ye, he was appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, concurrently Palace Attendant, and Commissioner to Console Henan.

sentences.zh: 仍與國子祭酒韓子熙並為侍講，授靜帝杜氏春秋。

translations.literal: He then served with Chancellor of the Imperial University Han Zixi as Lecturers, instructing Emperor Jing in the Du clan Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: He then served with Chancellor of the Imperial University Han Zixi as Lecturers, instructing Emperor Jing in the Du clan Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 又加散騎常侍，兼七兵尚書。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Regular Attendant of the Secretariat and concurrently Director of the Seventh Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed Regular Attendant of the Secretariat and concurrently Director of the Seventh Ministry.

sentences.zh: 尋拜侍中。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 興和二年卒。

translations.literal: He died in the second year of Xinghe.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Xinghe.

sentences.zh: 贈使持節、都督青徐光三州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、尚書右僕射、司徒公、青州刺史，諡曰文獻。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Area Commander-in-Chief over Qing, Xu, and Guang provinces, General of Agile Cavalry, Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Duke of the Secretariat, and Inspector of Qingzhou, with the posthumous title Wenxian.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Area Commander-in-Chief over Qing, Xu, and Guang provinces, General of Agile Cavalry, Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Duke of the Secretariat, and Inspector of Qingzhou, with the posthumous title Wenxian.

sentences.zh: 初，思同之為別駕也，清河崔光韶先為治中，自恃資地，耻居其下，聞思同還鄉，遂便去職。

translations.literal: When Sitong was Vice Prefect, Cui Guangshao of Qinghe had earlier served as Administrator; relying on his background, he was ashamed to rank below Sitong. When he heard Sitong was returning home, he immediately left office.
translations.idiomatic: When Sitong was Vice Prefect, Cui Guangshao of Qinghe had earlier served as Administrator; relying on his background, he was ashamed to rank below Sitong. When he heard Sitong was returning home, he immediately left office.

sentences.zh: 州里人物為思同恨之。

translations.literal: The leading men of the province resented this on Sitong's account.
translations.idiomatic: The leading men of the province resented this on Sitong's account.

sentences.zh: 及光韶之亡，遺誡子姪不聽求贈。

translations.literal: When Guangshao died, he left instructions to his sons and nephews not to seek posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangshao died, he left instructions to his sons and nephews not to seek posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 思同遂上表訟光韶操業，登時蒙贈諡。

translations.literal: Sitong thereupon submitted a memorial arguing Guangshao's integrity and conduct, and at once received posthumous enfeoffment and title.
translations.idiomatic: Sitong thereupon submitted a memorial arguing Guangshao's integrity and conduct, and at once received posthumous enfeoffment and title.

sentences.zh: 論者歎尚焉。

translations.literal: Commentators admired and praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators admired and praised this.

sentences.zh: 思同之侍講也，國子博士遼西衞冀隆為服氏之學，上書難杜氏春秋六十三事。

translations.literal: When Sitong served as Lecturer, Erudite Wei Jilong of Liaoxi, versed in the Fu clan learning, submitted a memorial challenging the Du clan Spring and Autumn Annals in sixty-three points.
translations.idiomatic: When Sitong served as Lecturer, Erudite Wei Jilong of Liaoxi, versed in the Fu clan learning, submitted a memorial challenging the Du clan Spring and Autumn Annals in sixty-three points.

sentences.zh: 思同復駁冀隆乖錯者十一條。

translations.literal: Sitong in turn refuted eleven points in which Jilong was mistaken.
translations.idiomatic: Sitong in turn refuted eleven points in which Jilong was mistaken.

sentences.zh: 互相是非，積成十卷。

translations.literal: Each challenged the other; this accumulated into ten chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Each challenged the other; this accumulated into ten chapters.

sentences.zh: 詔下國學集諸儒考之，事未竟而思同卒。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Imperial University to gather the Confucian scholars to examine it; the matter was not completed when Sitong died.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Imperial University to gather the Confucian scholars to examine it; the matter was not completed when Sitong died.

sentences.zh: 卒後，魏郡姚文安、樂陵秦道靜復述思同意。

translations.literal: After Sitong's death, Yao Wen'an of Wei Commandery and Qin Daojing of Leling further expounded Sitong's views.
translations.idiomatic: After Sitong's death, Yao Wen'an of Wei Commandery and Qin Daojing of Leling further expounded Sitong's views.

sentences.zh: 冀隆亦尋物故，浮陽劉休和又持冀隆說。

translations.literal: Jilong also soon died; Liu Xiuhe of Fuyang again upheld Jilong's position.
translations.idiomatic: Jilong also soon died; Liu Xiuhe of Fuyang again upheld Jilong's position.

sentences.zh: 至今未能裁正焉。

translations.literal: To this day the dispute has not been settled.
translations.idiomatic: To this day the dispute has not been settled.

sentences.zh: 李叔虎，勃海蓨人也。

translations.literal: Li Shuhu was a native of Tiao in Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shuhu was a native of Tiao in Bohai.

sentences.zh: 從祖金，世祖神䴥中與高允俱被徵，位至征南從事中郎。

translations.literal: His father's elder cousin Jin, in the Shengui era of Emperor Shizu, was summoned together with Gao Yun and reached the post of Acting Staff Officer in the Headquarters of the General Who Subdues the South.
translations.idiomatic: His father's elder cousin Jin, in the Shengui era of Emperor Shizu, was summoned together with Gao Yun and reached the post of Acting Staff Officer in the Headquarters of the General Who Subdues the South.

sentences.zh: 叔虎好學博聞，有識度，為鄉閭所稱。

translations.literal: Shuhu loved learning, was broadly informed, and had discernment; he was praised in his home district.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhu loved learning, was broadly informed, and had discernment; he was praised in his home district.

sentences.zh: 太和中，拜中書博士，與清河崔光、河間邢巒並相親友。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he was appointed Erudite in the Palace Library and was close friends with Cui Guang of Qinghe and Xing Luan of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he was appointed Erudite in the Palace Library and was close friends with Cui Guang of Qinghe and Xing Luan of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 轉議郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Reviewing Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Reviewing Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 久之，遷太尉從事中郎，轉國子博士、本國中正，攝樂陵中正。

translations.literal: After a long time he was transferred to Acting Staff Officer in the Grand Commandant's headquarters, then Erudite of the Imperial University and Chief Rectifier of his home commandery, concurrently acting as Rectifier of Leling.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was transferred to Acting Staff Officer in the Grand Commandant's headquarters, then Erudite of the Imperial University and Chief Rectifier of his home commandery, concurrently acting as Rectifier of Leling.

sentences.zh: 性清直，甚有公平之稱。

translations.literal: By nature he was pure and upright and had a great reputation for fairness.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was pure and upright and had a great reputation for fairness.

sentences.zh: 後兼散騎侍郎、太極都將。

translations.literal: Later he concurrently served as Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat and General of the Supreme Ultimate Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Later he concurrently served as Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat and General of the Supreme Ultimate Guard.

sentences.zh: 事訖，除高陽太守，固辭不拜。

translations.literal: When the assignment ended, he was appointed Administrator of Gaoyang but firmly declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: When the assignment ended, he was appointed Administrator of Gaoyang but firmly declined and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 尋除顯武將軍、太尉高陽王雍諮議參軍事，雍以其器操重之。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed General of Manifest Martiality and Advisory Staff Officer in the headquarters of the Prince of Gaoyang, Grand Commandant Yong, who valued him for his capacity and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed General of Manifest Martiality and Advisory Staff Officer in the headquarters of the Prince of Gaoyang, Grand Commandant Yong, who valued him for his capacity and integrity.

sentences.zh: 尋除假節、行華州事，為吏民所稱。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed with provisional staff of authority as Acting Inspector of Huazhou; officials and commoners praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed with provisional staff of authority as Acting Inspector of Huazhou; officials and commoners praised him.

sentences.zh: 永平四年卒，年五十四。

translations.literal: He died in the fourth year of Yongping at the age of fifty-four.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth year of Yongping at the age of fifty-four.

sentences.zh: 贈冠軍將軍、南青州刺史，諡曰穆。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded General of the Champions and Inspector of Southern Qingzhou, with the posthumous title Mu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded General of the Champions and Inspector of Southern Qingzhou, with the posthumous title Mu.

sentences.zh: 兄叔寶，州舉秀才，拜頓丘公國郎中令。

translations.literal: His elder brother Shubao, recommended by the province as a Filial and Incorrupt candidate, was appointed Gentleman of the Duke of Dunqiu's kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Shubao, recommended by the province as a Filial and Incorrupt candidate, was appointed Gentleman of the Duke of Dunqiu's kingdom.

sentences.zh: 遷太常丞。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Assistant Director of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Assistant Director of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 延昌末，叔寶為弟臺戶及從弟歸伯同沙門法慶反，陷破郡縣，叔寶當坐，遇病死於洛陽獄。

translations.literal: Near the end of the Yan chang era, Shubao's younger brother Taihu and his younger cousin Guibo joined the monk Fajing in rebellion with Shazhou, capturing and destroying commanderies and counties; Shubao should have been punished but happened to die of illness in Luoyang prison.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Yan chang era, Shubao's younger brother Taihu and his younger cousin Guibo joined the monk Fajing in rebellion with Shazhou, capturing and destroying commanderies and counties; Shubao should have been punished but happened to die of illness in Luoyang prison.

sentences.zh: 子伯冑，光祿大夫。

translations.literal: His son Bozhou served as Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: His son Bozhou served as Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 叔寶從弟鳳，歷尚書郎中、國子博士。

translations.literal: Shubao's younger cousin Feng served successively as Gentleman in the Ministry of Works and Erudite of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: Shubao's younger cousin Feng served successively as Gentleman in the Ministry of Works and Erudite of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 坐弟同京兆王愉逆，除名。

translations.literal: He was struck from the rolls for his younger brother's participation in Prince of Jingzhao Yu's rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: He was struck from the rolls for his younger brother's participation in Prince Yu of Jingzhao's rebellion.

sentences.zh: 鳳從子長仁，字景安。

translations.literal: Feng's younger cousin Changren, styled Jing'an.
translations.idiomatic: Feng's younger cousin Changren, styled Jing'an.

sentences.zh: 頗有學涉。

translations.literal: He possessed considerable learning.
translations.idiomatic: He possessed considerable learning.

sentences.zh: 舉秀才，射策高第。

translations.literal: Recommended as a Filial and Incorrupt candidate, he ranked high in the archery and policy examination.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended as a Filial and Incorrupt candidate, he ranked high in the archery and policy examination.

sentences.zh: 拜中書博士，轉中書侍郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed Erudite in the Palace Library and transferred to Attendant Gentleman in the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Erudite in the Palace Library and transferred to Attendant Gentleman in the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 累遷平南將軍、沛郡太守，仍為彭城太守。

translations.literal: He was promoted successively to General Who Pacifies the South and Administrator of Pei Commandery, then Administrator of Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted successively to General Who Pacifies the South and Administrator of Pei Commandery, then Administrator of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 又從尉元討定南境，賜爵延陵男。

translations.literal: He again followed Wei Yuan in pacifying the southern frontier and was enfeoffed as Baron of Yanling.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Wei Yuan in pacifying the southern frontier and was enfeoffed as Baron of Yanling.

sentences.zh: 徵拜員外散騎常侍，使於劉準。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Secretariat and sent as envoy to Liu Song.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned and appointed Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Secretariat and sent as envoy to Liu Song.

sentences.zh: 行還，以疾除北海內史，詔賜醫藥。

translations.literal: On returning from his mission he was removed on account of illness from the post of Inner Administrator of Beihai; an edict bestowed medicine on him.
translations.idiomatic: On returning from his mission he was removed on account of illness from the post of Inner Administrator of Beihai; an edict bestowed medicine on him.

sentences.zh: 凡在三郡，吏民安之。

translations.literal: In all three commanderies, officials and commoners were at peace under him.
translations.idiomatic: In all three commanderies, officials and commoners were at peace under him.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: He soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died.

sentences.zh: 武定中，贈安南將軍、七兵尚書、冀州刺史，男如故。

translations.literal: In the Wuding era he was posthumously awarded General Who Pacifies the South, Director of the Seventh Ministry, and Inspector of Jizhou, with his barony unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wuding era he was posthumously awarded General Who Pacifies the South, Director of the Seventh Ministry, and Inspector of Jizhou, with his barony unchanged.

sentences.zh: 長仁從弟述，字道興，有學識。

translations.literal: Changren's younger cousin Shu, styled Daoxing, possessed learning and discernment.
translations.idiomatic: Changren's younger cousin Shu, styled Daoxing, possessed learning and discernment.

sentences.zh: 州舉秀才。

translations.literal: Recommended by the province as a Filial and Incorrupt candidate.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended by the province as a Filial and Incorrupt candidate.

sentences.zh: 拜太常博士，使詣長安，冊祭燕宣王廟。

translations.literal: Appointed Erudite of the Imperial University, he was sent to Chang'an to issue the patent of enfeoffment at the temple of Prince Xuan of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed Erudite of the Imperial University, he was sent to Chang'an to issue the patent of enfeoffment at the temple of Prince Xuan of Yan.

sentences.zh: 還，除尚書儀曹郎，賜爵蓨縣男，稍遷建興太守。

translations.literal: On returning he was appointed Gentleman in the Ministry of Rites and Ceremonies and enfeoffed as Baron of Tiao, then gradually promoted to Administrator of Jianxing.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he was appointed Gentleman in the Ministry of Rites and Ceremonies and enfeoffed as Baron of Tiao, then gradually promoted to Administrator of Jianxing.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 子象，字孟則。

translations.literal: His son Xiang, styled Mengze.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xiang, styled Mengze.

sentences.zh: 清簡有風概，博涉羣書。

translations.literal: Pure and concise in bearing, with a fine reputation, he read widely in all books.
translations.idiomatic: Pure and concise in bearing, with a fine reputation, he read widely in all books.

sentences.zh: 初襲爵，為徐州平東府功曹參軍。

translations.literal: At first he inherited the title and served as Staff Officer in the Pingdong Headquarters of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At first he inherited the title and served as Staff Officer in the Pingdong Headquarters of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 遷冀州治中，有勤績。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Administrative Aide of Jizhou and had diligent achievements.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Administrative Aide of Jizhou and had diligent achievements.

sentences.zh: 久之，拜散騎侍郎，加寧朔將軍，尋轉中書侍郎。

translations.literal: After a long time he was appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat and additionally General Who Pacifies the North, soon transferred to Attendant Gentleman in the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat and additionally General Who Pacifies the North, soon transferred to Attendant Gentleman in the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 出為青州太傅開府諮議參軍、行北徐州事、本將軍、光祿大夫。

translations.literal: He went out as Advisory Staff Officer in the Grand Tutor's headquarters of Qingzhou, Acting Administrator of Northern Xuzhou, retaining his rank as Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as Advisory Staff Officer in the Grand Tutor's headquarters of Qingzhou, Acting Administrator of Northern Xuzhou, retaining his rank as Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 齊文襄王引為開府諮議參軍，加征東將軍。

translations.literal: Prince Wenxiang of Qi summoned him as Advisory Staff Officer in his headquarters and additionally appointed him General Who Conquers the East.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Wenxiang of Qi summoned him as Advisory Staff Officer in his headquarters and additionally appointed him General Who Conquers the East.

sentences.zh: 興和二年，兼散騎常侍，使於蕭衍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xinghe he concurrently served as Regular Attendant of the Secretariat and was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xinghe he concurrently served as Regular Attendant of the Secretariat and was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 三年卒，贈驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、冀州刺史，諡曰文簡，以子子貞預義之勤也。

translations.literal: He died in the third year and was posthumously awarded General of Agile Cavalry, Master of Ceremonies of the First Order, and Inspector of Jizhou, with the posthumous title Wenjian, because his son Zizhen shared in the merit of the righteous enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the third year and was posthumously awarded General of Agile Cavalry, Master of Ceremonies of the First Order, and Inspector of Jizhou, with the posthumous title Wenjian, because his son Zizhen shared in the merit of the righteous enterprise.

sentences.zh: 子貞，歷司空長史、武邑太守、司徒右長史、陽平太守。

translations.literal: Zizhen served successively as Chief Clerk of the Ministry of Works, Administrator of Wuyi, Right Chief Clerk of the Secretariat, and Administrator of Yangping.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhen served successively as Chief Clerk of the Ministry of Works, Administrator of Wuyi, Right Chief Clerk of the Secretariat, and Administrator of Yangping.

sentences.zh: 入為吏部郎中。

translations.literal: He entered service as Gentleman in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as Gentleman in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 出為驃騎將軍、兗州刺史。

translations.literal: He went out as General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 坐貪汙賜死。

translations.literal: He was sentenced to death for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: He was sentenced to death for corruption.

sentences.zh: 路恃慶，字伯瑞，陽平清淵人也。

translations.literal: Lu Shiqing, styled Borui, was a native of Qingyuan in Yangping.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shiqing, styled Borui, was a native of Qingyuan in Yangping.

sentences.zh: 祖綽，陽平太守。

translations.literal: His grandfather Chuo served as Administrator of Yangping.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Chuo served as Administrator of Yangping.

sentences.zh: 恃慶有幹用，與廣平宋翻俱知名，為鄉閭所稱，相州刺史李安世並表薦之。

translations.literal: Shiqing had administrative ability; he and Song Fan of Guangping were both famous and praised in their home district; Inspector Li Anshi of Xiangzhou memorialized recommending them both.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqing had administrative ability; he and Song Fan of Guangping were both famous and praised in their home district; Inspector Li Anshi of Xiangzhou memorialized recommending them both.

sentences.zh: 太和中，除奉朝請。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he was appointed Attendant at Court.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he was appointed Attendant at Court.

sentences.zh: 恃慶以從兄文舉有才望，因推讓之。

translations.literal: Shiqing, because his elder cousin Wenju had talent and reputation, yielded the appointment to him.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqing, because his elder cousin Wenju had talent and reputation, yielded the appointment to him.

sentences.zh: 高祖遂並拜焉。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu thereupon appointed them both.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu thereupon appointed them both.

sentences.zh: 稍遷尚書儀曹郎，轉左民郎，行潁川郡。

translations.literal: He was gradually promoted to Gentleman in the Ministry of Rites and Ceremonies, transferred to Gentleman in the Ministry of the Left, and acted as Administrator of Yingchuan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was gradually promoted to Gentleman in the Ministry of Rites and Ceremonies, transferred to Gentleman in the Ministry of the Left, and acted as Administrator of Yingchuan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 出為華州安定王征虜府長史。

translations.literal: He went out as Chief Clerk in the headquarters of Prince Ding'an of Hua, General Who Subdues the Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as Chief Clerk in the headquarters of Prince Ding'an of Hua, General Who Subdues the Barbarians.

sentences.zh: 尋以母憂去職。

translations.literal: Soon he left office on account of mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he left office on account of mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 仍轉定州河間王琛長史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Chief Clerk in the headquarters of Prince Hejian of Dingzhou, Chen.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Chief Clerk in the headquarters of Prince Hejian of Dingzhou, Chen.

sentences.zh: 琛貪暴肆意，恃慶每進苦言。

translations.literal: Chen was greedy and violent and acted arbitrarily; Shiqing often offered bitter remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: Chen was greedy and violent and acted arbitrarily; Shiqing often offered bitter remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 年四十八，卒。

translations.literal: He died at forty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He died at forty-eight.

sentences.zh: 贈左將軍、安州刺史，諡曰襄。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded General of the Left and Inspector of Anzhou, with the posthumous title Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded General of the Left and Inspector of Anzhou, with the posthumous title Xiang.

sentences.zh: 子祖璧，給事中。

translations.literal: His son Zubi served as Attendant in the Affairs Section.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zubi served as Attendant in the Affairs Section.

sentences.zh: 恃慶弟仲信，亦好學。

translations.literal: Shiqing's younger brother Zhongxin also loved learning.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqing's younger brother Zhongxin also loved learning.

sentences.zh: 為太尉參軍，稍遷奉車都尉、開府掾。

translations.literal: He served as Staff Officer in the Grand Commandant's headquarters and was gradually promoted to Commandant of the Imperial Carriages and Staff Officer in the headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Staff Officer in the Grand Commandant's headquarters and was gradually promoted to Commandant of the Imperial Carriages and Staff Officer in the headquarters.

sentences.zh: 章武王融之討葛榮也，仲信為其都督府長史。

translations.literal: When Prince of Zhangwu Rong campaigned against Ge Rong, Zhongxin served as Chief Clerk of his headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince of Zhangwu Rong campaigned against Ge Rong, Zhongxin served as Chief Clerk of his headquarters.

sentences.zh: 融敗歿，仲信遂亦免棄。

translations.literal: When Rong was defeated and killed, Zhongxin was also dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When Rong was defeated and killed, Zhongxin was also dismissed.

sentences.zh: 仲信弟思略，字叔約，有識尚。

translations.literal: Zhongxin's younger brother Silue, styled Shuyue, had discernment and high ideals.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxin's younger brother Silue, styled Shuyue, had discernment and high ideals.

sentences.zh: 冀州安東府騎軍參軍。

translations.literal: Cavalry Staff Officer in the Eastern Headquarters of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry Staff Officer in the Eastern Headquarters of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 子祖遺，武定末，太學博士。

translations.literal: His son Zuyi, at the end of the Wuding era, served as Erudite of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zuyi, at the end of the Wuding era, served as Erudite of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 思略弟思令，字季儁。

translations.literal: Silue's younger brother Siling, styled Jijun.
translations.idiomatic: Silue's younger brother Siling, styled Jijun.

sentences.zh: 初為廣陽王司空參軍，轉司空城局參軍、司徒記室、威遠將軍、尚書左民郎，轉右民。

translations.literal: At first he served as Staff Officer in the Ministry of Works of Prince of Guangyang, transferred to Staff Officer in the City Bureau of the Ministry of Works and Recorder in the Secretariat, General Who Expands the Distance, and Gentleman in the Ministry of the Left, then transferred to the Ministry of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: At first he served as Staff Officer in the Ministry of Works of Prince of Guangyang, transferred to Staff Officer in the City Bureau of the Ministry of Works and Recorder in the Secretariat, General Who Expands the Distance, and Gentleman in the Ministry of the Left, then transferred to the Ministry of the Right.

sentences.zh: 時天下多事，思令乃上疏曰：「臣聞國之大事，唯祀與戎。

translations.literal: At that time the realm was troubled in many ways; Siling thereupon submitted a memorial saying: "I have heard that the great affairs of a state are sacrifice and war.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the realm was troubled in many ways; Siling thereupon submitted a memorial saying: "I have heard that the great affairs of a state are sacrifice and war.

sentences.zh: 戎之有功，在於將帥。

translations.literal: In war, merit lies in the generals.
translations.idiomatic: In war, merit lies in the generals.

sentences.zh: 三代不必別民，取治不等；

translations.literal: The Three Dynasties did not necessarily separate the people; their methods of rule were not equal;
translations.idiomatic: The Three Dynasties did not necessarily separate the people; their methods of rule were not equal;

sentences.zh: 五霸不必異兵，各能克定。

translations.literal: the Five Hegemons did not necessarily use different armies; each could subdue and settle.
translations.idiomatic: the Five Hegemons did not necessarily use different armies; each could subdue and settle.

sentences.zh: 有湯武之賢，猶須伊望之佐；

translations.literal: Even with the worthies of Tang and Wu, one still needed the assistance of Yi Yin and Wangwang;
translations.idiomatic: Even with the worthies of Tang and Wu, one still needed the assistance of Yi Yin and Taigong;

sentences.zh: 堯舜之聖，尚有稷契之輔。

translations.literal: even with the sages Yao and Shun, there were still Ji and Qi to assist.
translations.idiomatic: even with the sages Yao and Shun, there were still Hou Ji and Qi to assist.

sentences.zh: 得其人也，六合唾掌可清；

translations.literal: If one obtains the right man, the realm can be pacified at a gesture;
translations.idiomatic: If one obtains the right man, the realm can be pacified at a gesture;

sentences.zh: 失其人也，三河方為戰地。

translations.literal: if one loses the right man, the three rivers become a battlefield.
translations.idiomatic: if one loses the right man, the three rivers become a battlefield.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 動之甚易，靖之至難。

translations.literal: Disturbing is very easy; pacifying is extremely hard.
translations.idiomatic: Disturbing is very easy; pacifying is extremely hard.

sentences.zh: 竊以比年以來，將帥多是寵貴子孫，軍幢統領，亦皆故義託附。

translations.literal: I privately consider that in recent years generals have mostly been favored noble descendants, and military commanders and leaders have also been old retainers and dependents.
translations.idiomatic: I privately consider that in recent years generals have mostly been favored noble descendants, and military commanders and leaders have also been old retainers and dependents.

sentences.zh: 貴戚子弟未經戎役，至於銜杯躍馬，志逸氣浮，軒眉攘腕，便以攻戰自許。

translations.literal: Noble sons and younger brothers who have not undergone military service, when it comes to raising cups and leaping on horses, their will is at ease and their spirit floats; they arch their brows and roll up their sleeves and on that basis boast of attack and battle.
translations.idiomatic: Noble sons and younger brothers who have not undergone military service, when it comes to raising cups and leaping on horses, their will is at ease and their spirit floats; they arch their brows and roll up their sleeves and on that basis boast of attack and battle.

sentences.zh: 及臨大敵，怖懼交懷，雄圖銳氣，一朝頓盡。

translations.literal: When facing a great enemy, fear and dread mingle in their hearts; bold designs and sharp spirit vanish in a morning.
translations.idiomatic: When facing a great enemy, fear and dread mingle in their hearts; bold designs and sharp spirit vanish in a morning.

sentences.zh: 乃令羸弱在前以當銳，強壯居後以安身。

translations.literal: Then they place the weak in front to meet the sharp edge and keep the strong in the rear to preserve themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Then they place the weak in front to meet the sharp edge and keep the strong in the rear to preserve themselves.

sentences.zh: 兼復器械不精，進止不集，任羊質之將，驅不練之兵，當負險之眾，敵數戰之虜，欲令不敗，豈有得哉！

translations.literal: Moreover weapons are not refined and advance and retreat are not coordinated; they employ generals of sheep's substance and drive untrained troops against a numerous enemy holding strong terrain— how could they not be defeated?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover weapons are not refined and advance and retreat are not coordinated; they employ generals of sheep's substance and drive untrained troops against a numerous enemy holding strong terrain— how could they not be defeated?

sentences.zh: 是以兵知必敗，始集而先逃；

translations.literal: Thus the soldiers, knowing they must lose, gather only to flee first;
translations.idiomatic: Thus the soldiers, knowing they must lose, gather only to flee first;

sentences.zh: 將又怖敵，遷延而不進。

translations.literal: the generals again fear the enemy and delay without advancing.
translations.idiomatic: the generals again fear the enemy and delay without advancing.

sentences.zh: 國家便謂官號未滿，重爵屢加，復疑賞賚之輕，金帛日賜。

translations.literal: The state then says the official title is not full enough and repeatedly adds noble ranks; again suspecting rewards are too light, gold and silk are bestowed daily.
translations.idiomatic: The state then says the official title is not full enough and repeatedly adds noble ranks; again suspecting rewards are too light, gold and silk are bestowed daily.

sentences.zh: 帑藏空虛，民財殫盡。

translations.literal: The treasury is emptied and the people's wealth exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: The treasury is emptied and the people's wealth exhausted.

sentences.zh: 致使賊徒更增，膽氣益盛，生民損耗，荼毒無聊。

translations.literal: This causes the bandits to grow more numerous, their daring and spirit to increase daily, the living people to suffer loss, and bitter poison without respite.
translations.idiomatic: This causes the bandits to grow more numerous, their daring and spirit to increase daily, the living people to suffer loss, and bitter poison without respite.

sentences.zh: 主歎臣哀，何心寢食。

translations.literal: The lord sighs and ministers grieve— how can one eat or sleep in peace?
translations.idiomatic: The lord sighs and ministers grieve— how can one eat or sleep in peace?

sentences.zh: 臣雖位微，竊不遑舍。

translations.literal: Though my position is low, I dare not neglect this.
translations.idiomatic: Though my position is low, I dare not neglect this.

sentences.zh: 臣聞孝行出於忠貞，節義率多果決。

translations.literal: I have heard that filial conduct springs from loyal fidelity, and integrity and righteousness mostly come from decisive action.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that filial conduct springs from loyal fidelity, and integrity and righteousness mostly come from decisive action.

sentences.zh: 德可感義夫，恩可勸死士。

translations.literal: Virtue can move men of righteousness; grace can encourage men who will die.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue can move men of righteousness; grace can encourage men who will die.

sentences.zh: 今若捨上所輕，求下所重。

translations.literal: Now if we discard what superiors lightly esteem and seek what inferiors heavily esteem,
translations.idiomatic: Now if we discard what superiors lightly esteem and seek what inferiors heavily esteem,

sentences.zh: 黜陟幽明，賞罰善惡。

translations.literal: dismiss and promote the obscure and the clear, reward and punish good and evil,
translations.idiomatic: dismiss and promote the obscure and the clear, reward and punish good and evil,

sentences.zh: 搜徒簡卒，練兵習武，甲密弩強，弓調矢勁。

translations.literal: search out soldiers and select troops, drill the army and practice martial arts, with dense armor and strong crossbows, bows tuned and arrows keen,
translations.idiomatic: search out soldiers and select troops, drill the army and practice martial arts, with dense armor and strong crossbows, bows tuned and arrows keen,

sentences.zh: 謀夫既設，辯士先陳，曉以安危，示其禍福。

translations.literal: strategists established and eloquent men sent ahead to explain safety and danger and show fortune and misfortune,
translations.idiomatic: strategists established and eloquent men sent ahead to explain safety and danger and show fortune and misfortune,

sentences.zh: 如其不悛，以我義順之師討茲悖逆之豎，豈異厲蕭斧而伐朝菌，鼓洪爐而燎毛髮，雖愚者知其不旋踵矣。

translations.literal: if they do not repent, with our righteous army of obedience we shall punish these rebellious villains— is it not like wielding a sharp axe to cut morning mushrooms, or stirring a great furnace to singe hair? Even fools know they will not turn back.
translations.idiomatic: if they do not repent, with our righteous army of obedience we shall punish these rebellious villains— is it not like wielding a sharp axe to cut morning mushrooms, or stirring a great furnace to singe hair? Even fools know they will not turn back.

sentences.zh: 敢以愚短，昧死陳誠。」

translations.literal: I dare, with my foolish brevity, risk death to state my sincerity."
translations.idiomatic: I dare, with my foolish brevity, risk death to state my sincerity."

sentences.zh: 尋拜假節、征虜將軍、陽平太守。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed with provisional staff of authority as General Who Subdues the Barbarians and Administrator of Yangping.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed with provisional staff of authority as General Who Subdues the Barbarians and Administrator of Yangping.

sentences.zh: 又割冀州之清河、相州之陽平、齊州之平原以為南冀州，[5]仍以思令為左將軍、南冀州刺史、假平東將軍、都督。

translations.literal: Moreover Qinghe of Jizhou, Yangping of Xiangzhou, and Pingyuan of Qizhou were carved out to form Southern Jizhou, [5] and Siling was appointed General of the Left, Inspector of Southern Jizhou, and provisional General Who Pacifies the East and Area Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Qinghe of Jizhou, Yangping of Xiangzhou, and Pingyuan of Qizhou were carved out to form Southern Jizhou, [5] and Siling was appointed General of the Left, Inspector of Southern Jizhou, and provisional General Who Pacifies the East and Area Commander.

sentences.zh: 時葛榮遣其清河太守季虎據高唐城以招叛民，[6]思令乃命麾下并率鄉曲潛軍夜往，出其不意，遂大破之，徐乃收眾南還。

translations.literal: At that time Ge Rong sent his Administrator of Qinghe, Ji Hu, to hold Gaotang city and win over rebellious commoners; [6] Siling ordered his subordinates and also led local levies in a night march by secret route, taking them unawares, and routed them completely; only afterward did he gather his troops and return south.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Ge Rong sent his Administrator of Qinghe, Ji Hu, to hold Gaotang city and win over rebellious commoners; [6] Siling ordered his subordinates and also led local levies in a night march by secret route, taking them unawares, and routed them completely; only afterward did he gather his troops and return south.

sentences.zh: 又詔思令并領冀州流民。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered Siling concurrently to oversee the displaced people of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered Siling concurrently to oversee the displaced people of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 及葛榮滅，還鎮平原。

translations.literal: When Ge Rong was destroyed, he returned to garrison Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Ge Rong was destroyed, he returned to garrison Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 後除征東將軍、金紫光祿大夫，轉衞將軍、右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed General Who Conquers the East and Grand Master of the Palace with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, transferred to General of the Guard and Grand Master of the Palace with Right Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was appointed General Who Conquers the East and Grand Master of the Palace with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, transferred to General of the Guard and Grand Master of the Palace with Right Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 天平三年三月卒，時年五十一。

translations.literal: He died in the third month of the third year of Tianping at the age of fifty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the third month of the third year of Tianping at the age of fifty-one.

sentences.zh: 贈驃騎將軍、定州刺史。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 恃慶從叔景略，起家中書博士。

translations.literal: Shiqing's younger cousin Jinglue began his career as Erudite in the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqing's younger cousin Jinglue began his career as Erudite in the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 太和中，尚書郎、本郡中正。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he served as Gentleman in the Ministry of Works and Chief Rectifier of his home commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he served as Gentleman in the Ministry of Works and Chief Rectifier of his home commandery.

sentences.zh: 出為齊州魏郡、平原二郡太守。

translations.literal: He went out as Administrator of the two commanderies of Wei and Pingyuan in Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as Administrator of the two commanderies of Wei and Pingyuan in Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 景略弟雄，字仲略，容貌偉異。

translations.literal: Jinglue's younger brother Xiong, styled Zhonglue, had a striking and unusual appearance.
translations.idiomatic: Jinglue's younger brother Xiong, styled Zhonglue, had a striking and unusual appearance.

sentences.zh: 以軍功為給事中。

translations.literal: On account of military merit he served as Attendant in the Affairs Section.
translations.idiomatic: On account of military merit he served as Attendant in the Affairs Section.

sentences.zh: 高祖曾對羣臣云：「路仲略好尚書郎才。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu once said to the assembled ministers: "Lu Zhonglue has the talent of a Gentleman in the Ministry of Works."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu once said to the assembled ministers: "Lu Zhonglue has the talent of a Gentleman in the Ministry of Works."

sentences.zh: 」僕射李沖云：「其人宜為武職。

translations.literal: Vice Director Li Chong said: "This man is suited for a military post."
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Li Chong said: "This man is suited for a military post."

sentences.zh: 」遂停。

translations.literal: The matter was halted.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was halted.

sentences.zh: 轉太尉咸陽王錄事參軍，遷伏波將軍、奉車都尉。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Recorder in the headquarters of the Prince of Xianyang and promoted to General Who Subdues Waves and Commandant of the Imperial Carriages.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Recorder in the headquarters of the Prince of Xianyang and promoted to General Who Subdues Waves and Commandant of the Imperial Carriages.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈頓丘太守。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously awarded Administrator of Dunqiu.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously awarded Administrator of Dunqiu.

sentences.zh: 景略從祖弟法常，幼而修立。

translations.literal: Jinglue's younger cousin Fachang, though young, cultivated himself and stood firm.
translations.idiomatic: Jinglue's younger cousin Fachang, though young, cultivated himself and stood firm.

sentences.zh: 為郡功曹。

translations.literal: He served as Merit Officer of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Merit Officer of the commandery.

sentences.zh: 早卒。

translations.literal: He died young.
translations.idiomatic: He died young.

sentences.zh: 儀同李神儁與之有舊，每云：「諸路前輩中有路法常足為名士，謂必遠至，而竟無年，天下事誠難知也。」

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Li Shenjun, who was old friends with him, often said: "Among the senior men of the Lu family, Lu Fachang was enough to be a famous gentleman— one thought he would go far, yet he had no years; affairs in the world are truly hard to know."
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Li Shenjun, who was old friends with him, often said: "Among the senior men of the Lu family, Lu Fachang was enough to be a famous gentleman— one thought he would go far, yet he had no years; affairs in the world are truly hard to know."

sentences.zh: 房亮，字景高，清河人也。

translations.literal: Fang Liang, styled Jinggao, was a native of Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Liang, styled Jinggao, was a native of Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 父法延，譙郡太守。

translations.literal: His father Fayian served as Administrator of Qiao Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Fayian served as Administrator of Qiao Commandery.

sentences.zh: 亮好學，有節操。

translations.literal: Liang loved learning and had integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Liang loved learning and had integrity.

sentences.zh: 太和中，舉秀才，為奉朝請。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he was recommended as a Filial and Incorrupt candidate and served as Attendant at Court.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he was recommended as a Filial and Incorrupt candidate and served as Attendant at Court.

sentences.zh: 拜祕書郎，又兼員外散騎侍郎，副中書侍郎宋弁使於蕭賾。

translations.literal: He was appointed Secretary and concurrently Supernumerary Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat, assisting Attendant Gentleman in the Palace Library Song Bian on a mission to Xiao Ze.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Secretary and concurrently Supernumerary Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat, assisting Attendant Gentleman in the Palace Library Song Bian on a mission to Xiao Ze.

sentences.zh: 還，除尚書二千石郎中、濟州中正。

translations.literal: On returning he was appointed Gentleman of the Two Thousand Stone Rank in the Ministry of Works and Chief Rectifier of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he was appointed Gentleman of the Two Thousand Stone Rank in the Ministry of Works and Chief Rectifier of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 兼員外常侍，使高麗，高麗王託疾不拜。

translations.literal: Concurrently Supernumerary Regular Attendant, he was sent to Goguryeo; the King of Goguryeo pleaded illness and did not perform the bowing ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Concurrently Supernumerary Regular Attendant, he was sent to Goguryeo; the King of Goguryeo pleaded illness and did not perform the bowing ceremony.

sentences.zh: 以亮辱命，坐白衣守郎中。

translations.literal: Because Liang had disgraced his commission, he was punished by serving as a commoner while retaining his post as Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Because Liang had disgraced his commission, he was punished by serving as a commoner while retaining his post as Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 後除濟北太守，轉平原太守，以清嚴稱。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed Administrator of Jibei, transferred to Administrator of Pingyuan, and was known for purity and strictness.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was appointed Administrator of Jibei, transferred to Administrator of Pingyuan, and was known for purity and strictness.

sentences.zh: 時冀州刺史、京兆王愉據州反，平原界在河北，與愉接境。

translations.literal: At that time Inspector of Jizhou, Prince of Jingzhao Yu, held the province in rebellion; Pingyuan's border lay north of the Yellow River and adjoined Yu's territory.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Inspector of Jizhou, Prince Yu of Jingzhao, held the province in rebellion; Pingyuan's border lay north of the Yellow River and adjoined Yu's territory.

sentences.zh: 愉乃遣人說亮，啖以榮利。

translations.literal: Yu thereupon sent men to persuade Liang, tempting him with glory and profit.
translations.idiomatic: Yu thereupon sent men to persuade Liang, tempting him with glory and profit.

sentences.zh: 亮即斬其使人，發兵防捍。

translations.literal: Liang immediately executed Yu's envoys and mobilized troops to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Liang immediately executed Yu's envoys and mobilized troops to defend.

sentences.zh: 愉怒，遣其大將張靈和率眾攻亮。

translations.literal: Yu was enraged and sent his great general Zhang Linghe to lead troops to attack Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was enraged and sent his great general Zhang Linghe to lead troops to attack Liang.

sentences.zh: 亮督厲兵民，喻以逆順，出城拒擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Liang supervised and encouraged soldiers and commoners, explained rebellion and obedience, went out of the city to resist and attack, and routed them completely.
translations.idiomatic: Liang supervised and encouraged soldiers and commoners, explained rebellion and obedience, went out of the city to resist and attack, and routed them completely.

sentences.zh: 尋遭憂解任。

translations.literal: Soon he was removed on account of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was removed on account of mourning.

sentences.zh: 服終，除左將軍、汲郡太守。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed General of the Left and Administrator of Ji Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was appointed General of the Left and Administrator of Ji Commandery.

sentences.zh: 遷前將軍、東荊州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to General of the Vanguard and Inspector of Eastern Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to General of the Vanguard and Inspector of Eastern Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 亮留心撫納，夷夏安之。

translations.literal: Liang devoted himself to comforting and accepting the people; both barbarians and Chinese were at peace under him.
translations.idiomatic: Liang devoted himself to comforting and accepting the people; both barbarians and Chinese were at peace under him.

sentences.zh: 時邊州刺史例得一子出身，亮不言其子而啟弟子超為奉朝請。

translations.literal: At that time frontier Inspectors by precedent could obtain office for one son; Liang did not mention his son but memorialized that his younger brother's son Chao should serve as Attendant at Court.
translations.idiomatic: At that time frontier Inspectors by precedent could obtain office for one son; Liang did not mention his son but memorialized that his younger brother's son Chao should serve as Attendant at Court.

sentences.zh: 議者稱之。

translations.literal: Commentators praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators praised this.

sentences.zh: 轉平東將軍、滄州刺史，入為光祿大夫，加安東將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to General Who Pacifies the East and Inspector of Cangzhou, entered service as Grand Master of the Palace, and was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to General Who Pacifies the East and Inspector of Cangzhou, entered service as Grand Master of the Palace, and was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 永安二年卒，年七十一。

translations.literal: He died in the second year of Yongan at the age of seventy-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Yongan at the age of seventy-one.

sentences.zh: 贈撫軍將軍、齊州刺史。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 子柬，字元約。

translations.literal: His son Jian, styled Yuanyue.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jian, styled Yuanyue.

sentences.zh: 卒於光祿大夫。

translations.literal: He died while serving as Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He died while serving as Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 亮弟詮，字鳳舉。

translations.literal: Liang's younger brother Quan, styled Fengju.
translations.idiomatic: Liang's younger brother Quan, styled Fengju.

sentences.zh: 尚書郎、本州中正。

translations.literal: Gentleman in the Ministry of Works and Chief Rectifier of his home province.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman in the Ministry of Works and Chief Rectifier of his home province.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈撫軍將軍、齊州刺史。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously awarded General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously awarded General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 詮弟悅，字季欣。

translations.literal: Quan's younger brother Yue, styled Jixin.
translations.idiomatic: Quan's younger brother Yue, styled Jixin.

sentences.zh: 解褐廣平王懷國常侍，轉青州平東府中兵參軍，加宣威將軍。

translations.literal: He began his career as Regular Attendant of the Prince of Guangping Huai's kingdom, transferred to Central Army Staff Officer in the Pingdong Headquarters of Qingzhou, and was additionally appointed General Who Proclaims Martiality.
translations.idiomatic: He began his career as Regular Attendant of the Prince of Guangping Huai's kingdom, transferred to Central Army Staff Officer in the Pingdong Headquarters of Qingzhou, and was additionally appointed General Who Proclaims Martiality.

sentences.zh: 遷高陽太守，轉廣川太守，加鎮遠將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Administrator of Gaoyang, then Administrator of Guangchuan, and was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the Distance.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Administrator of Gaoyang, then Administrator of Guangchuan, and was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the Distance.

sentences.zh: 普泰中，濟州刺史張瓊表所部置南清河郡，仍請悅為太守，朝廷從之。

translations.literal: During the Putai era, Inspector of Jizhou Zhang Qiong memorialized that within his jurisdiction a Southern Qinghe Commandery should be established, and requested Yue as Administrator; the court approved.
translations.idiomatic: During the Putai era, Inspector of Jizhou Zhang Qiong memorialized that within his jurisdiction a Southern Qinghe Commandery should be established, and requested Yue as Administrator; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 凡歷三郡，民吏安之。

translations.literal: In all three commanderies he served, officials and commoners were at peace under him.
translations.idiomatic: In all three commanderies he served, officials and commoners were at peace under him.

sentences.zh: 遷平東將軍、太中大夫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to General Who Pacifies the East and Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to General Who Pacifies the East and Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 興和二年卒，年七十。

translations.literal: He died in the second year of Xinghe at the age of seventy.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Xinghe at the age of seventy.

sentences.zh: 贈征東將軍、濟州刺史。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded General Who Conquers the East and Inspector of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded General Who Conquers the East and Inspector of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 長子超，字伯穎。

translations.literal: His eldest son Chao, styled Boying.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Chao, styled Boying.

sentences.zh: 武定末，司徒錄事參軍、濟州大中正。

translations.literal: At the end of the Wuding era he served as Recorder in the Secretariat and Chief Rectifier of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Wuding era he served as Recorder in the Secretariat and Chief Rectifier of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 超弟昭，淮州驃騎大將軍府長史。

translations.literal: Chao's younger brother Zhao served as Chief Clerk in the headquarters of the General of Agile Cavalry of Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chao's younger brother Zhao served as Chief Clerk in the headquarters of the General of Agile Cavalry of Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 曹世表，字景昇，東魏郡魏人也。

translations.literal: Cao Shibiao, styled Jingsheng, was a native of Wei in Eastern Wei Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Shibiao, styled Jingsheng, was a native of Wei in Eastern Wei Commandery.

sentences.zh: 魏大司馬休九世孫。

translations.literal: He was the ninth-generation descendant of the Grand Marshal of Wei, Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: He was the ninth-generation descendant of the Grand Marshal of Wei, Xiu.

sentences.zh: 祖謨，父慶，並有學名。

translations.literal: His grandfather Mo and father Qing both had reputations for learning.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Mo and father Qing both had reputations for learning.

sentences.zh: 世表少喪父，舉止有禮度。

translations.literal: Shibiao lost his father young; his conduct and deportment had proper measure.
translations.idiomatic: Shibiao lost his father young; his conduct and deportment had proper measure.

sentences.zh: 性雅正，工尺牘，涉獵羣書。

translations.literal: By nature he was refined and correct, skilled at letters, and read widely in all books.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was refined and correct, skilled at letters, and read widely in all books.

sentences.zh: 太和二十三年，尚書僕射、任城王澄奏世表為國子助教，頗失意。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Taihe, Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Prince of Rencheng Cheng, memorialized that Shibiao should serve as Assistant Erudite of the Imperial University; he was quite disappointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Taihe, Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Prince of Rencheng Cheng, memorialized that Shibiao should serve as Assistant Erudite of the Imperial University; he was quite disappointed.

sentences.zh: 後轉司徒記室。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to Recorder in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was transferred to Recorder in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 與武威賈思伯、范陽盧同、隴西辛雄等並相友善。

translations.literal: He was close friends with Jia Sibo of Wuwei, Lu Tong of Fanyang, and Xin Xiong of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was close friends with Jia Sibo of Wuwei, Lu Tong of Fanyang, and Xin Xiong of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 侍中崔光，鄉里貴達，每稱美之。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Cui Guang, noble and prominent in their home district, often praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Cui Guang, noble and prominent in their home district, often praised him.

sentences.zh: 遇患歸鄉。

translations.literal: He fell ill and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: He fell ill and returned home.

sentences.zh: 永平中，除兗州左將軍府司馬，非其所願，復以病解。

translations.literal: In the Yongping era he was appointed Army Supervisor in the headquarters of the General of the Left of Yanzhou; it was not what he wished, and he again resigned on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongping era he was appointed Army Supervisor in the headquarters of the General of the Left of Yanzhou; it was not what he wished, and he again resigned on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 延昌中，除清河太守，治官省約，百姓安之。

translations.literal: In the Yan chang era he was appointed Administrator of Qinghe; in office he was economical and simple, and the common people were at peace under him.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yan chang era he was appointed Administrator of Qinghe; in office he was economical and simple, and the common people were at peace under him.

sentences.zh: 正光中，拜前將軍、通直散騎常侍。

translations.literal: In the Zhengguang era he was appointed General of the Vanguard and Regular Attendant of the Secretariat Through Direct Communications.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhengguang era he was appointed General of the Vanguard and Regular Attendant of the Secretariat Through Direct Communications.

sentences.zh: 大將軍、京兆王繼西征，以為從事中郎，攝中水兵事，自當煩劇，論者皆稱其能。

translations.literal: When the Great General, Prince of Jingzhao Ji, campaigned westward, Shibiao served as Attendant Gentleman and supervised the central river military affairs; though the duties were pressing and heavy, commentators all praised his ability.
translations.idiomatic: When the Great General, Prince Ji of Jingzhao, campaigned westward, Shibiao served as Attendant Gentleman and supervised the central river military affairs; though the duties were pressing and heavy, commentators all praised his ability.

sentences.zh: 還都，拜司空長史。

translations.literal: On returning to the capital he was appointed Chief Clerk of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the capital he was appointed Chief Clerk of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 孝昌中，青齊頻年反亂，詔世表持節慰喻。

translations.literal: In the Xiaochang era Qing and Qi suffered rebellion year after year; an edict ordered Shibiao to hold the staff of authority and console and explain.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiaochang era Qing and Qi suffered rebellion year after year; an edict ordered Shibiao to hold the staff of authority and console and explain.

sentences.zh: 還都，轉尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On returning to the capital he was transferred to Vice Director of the Right in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the capital he was transferred to Vice Director of the Right in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 後加征虜將軍，出行豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Later he was additionally appointed General Who Subdues the Barbarians and went out as Acting Inspector of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was additionally appointed General Who Subdues the Barbarians and went out as Acting Inspector of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 值蕭衍將湛僧珍陷東豫州，州民劉獲、鄭辯反於州界，為之內應。

translations.literal: When Xiao Yan's general Zhan Sengzhen captured Eastern Yuzhou, the provincial people Liu Huo and Zheng Bian rebelled within the province as internal collaborators.
