translations.idiomatic: When Xiao Yan's general Zhan Sengzhen captured Eastern Yuzhou, the provincial people Liu Huo and Zheng Bian rebelled within the province as internal collaborators.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以源子恭代世表為州，以世表為東南道行臺，率元安平、元顯伯、皇甫鄧林等討之。

translations.literal: The court replaced Shibiao with Yuan Zigong as Inspector and appointed Shibiao Area Commander on the Southeastern Route, leading Yuan Anping, Yuan Xianbo, Huangfu Denglin, and others to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The court replaced Shibiao with Yuan Zigong as Inspector and appointed Shibiao Area Commander on the Southeastern Route, leading Yuan Anping, Yuan Xianbo, Huangfu Denglin, and others to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 於時賊眾強斷小殷關，驛使不通。

translations.literal: At that time the rebels strongly cut off the Xiao Yin Pass; courier messengers could not pass.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the rebels strongly cut off the Xiao Yin Pass; courier messengers could not pass.

sentences.zh: 諸將以士馬單少，皆敗散之餘，不敢復戰，咸欲保城自固。

translations.literal: The generals, because troops and horses were few and they were remnants after defeat, dared not fight again and all wished to hold the city and defend themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The generals, because troops and horses were few and they were remnants after defeat, dared not fight again and all wished to hold the city and defend themselves.

sentences.zh: 世表時患背腫，乃輿病出外，呼統軍是云寶謂之曰：「湛僧珍所以敢深入為寇者，以獲、辯皆州民之望，為之內應。

translations.literal: Shibiao was then afflicted with a back abscess; he had himself carried outside and called the commander Shi Yunbao, saying to him: "Zhan Sengzhen dares to penetrate deeply as a raider because Liu Huo and Zheng Bian, both men the province looks to, serve as his internal collaborators.
translations.idiomatic: Shibiao was then afflicted with a back abscess; he had himself carried outside and called the commander Shi Yunbao, saying to him: "Zhan Sengzhen dares to penetrate deeply as a raider because Liu Huo and Zheng Bian, both men the province looks to, serve as his internal collaborators.

sentences.zh: 向有驛至，知劉獲移軍欲迎僧珍，去此八十里。

translations.literal: Until now couriers arrived reporting that Liu Huo was moving his army to meet Sengzhen, eighty li from here.
translations.idiomatic: Until now couriers arrived reporting that Liu Huo was moving his army to meet Sengzhen, eighty li from here.

sentences.zh: 今出其不意，一戰可破。

translations.literal: Now, taking them unawares, one battle can break them.
translations.idiomatic: Now, taking them unawares, one battle can break them.

sentences.zh: 獲破，則僧珍自走，東南清服，卿之功也。

translations.literal: If Huo is broken, Sengzhen will withdraw of himself; the southeast will be pacified— the merit is yours."
translations.idiomatic: If Huo is broken, Sengzhen will withdraw of himself; the southeast will be pacified— the merit is yours."

sentences.zh: 」乃簡選兵馬，付寶討之。

translations.literal: He thereupon selected troops and horses and entrusted them to Bao to suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon selected troops and horses and entrusted them to Bao to suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 促令發軍，日暮出城，比曉兵合。

translations.literal: He urgently ordered the army to set out; at dusk they left the city, and by dawn the troops had assembled.
translations.idiomatic: He urgently ordered the army to set out; at dusk they left the city, and by dawn the troops had assembled.

sentences.zh: 賊不意官軍卒至，一戰破獲，諸賊悉平，湛僧珍退走。

translations.literal: The rebels did not expect the government army to arrive so suddenly; in one battle Huo was broken and all the bandits were pacified; Zhan Sengzhen withdrew and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels did not expect the government army to arrive so suddenly; in one battle Huo was broken and all the bandits were pacified; Zhan Sengzhen withdrew and fled.

sentences.zh: 唯鄭辯與子恭親舊，亡匿子恭所。

translations.literal: Only Zheng Bian, being an old associate of Zigong, hid in Zigong's quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Only Zheng Bian, being an old associate of Zigong, hid in Zigong's quarters.

sentences.zh: 世表召諸將吏，眾責子恭，收辯斬之，傳首京師。

translations.literal: Shibiao summoned the generals and clerks, publicly rebuked Zigong, seized Bian and executed him, and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shibiao summoned the generals and clerks, publicly rebuked Zigong, seized Bian and executed him, and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 敕遣中使宣旨慰喻，賜馬二匹、衣服被褥。

translations.literal: An edict sent a palace envoy to proclaim imperial intent and console him, bestowing two horses and clothing, bedding, and coverlets.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent a palace envoy to proclaim imperial intent and console him, bestowing two horses and clothing, bedding, and coverlets.

sentences.zh: 復以世表行豫州事，行臺如故。

translations.literal: Shibiao again acted as Inspector of Yuzhou with his Area Command unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Shibiao again acted as Inspector of Yuzhou with his Area Command unchanged.

sentences.zh: 還朝，加左將軍，兼尚書東道行臺，沿河分立鎮戍，以備葛榮。

translations.literal: On returning to court he was additionally appointed General of the Left and concurrently Area Commander on the Eastern Route of the Ministry of Works; along the river he established garrisons to guard against Ge Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to court he was additionally appointed General of the Left and concurrently Area Commander on the Eastern Route of the Ministry of Works; along the river he established garrisons to guard against Ge Rong.

sentences.zh: 行達青州，遇患卒，時年五十四。

translations.literal: En route he reached Qingzhou, fell ill, and died at the age of fifty-four.
translations.idiomatic: En route he reached Qingzhou, fell ill, and died at the age of fifty-four.

sentences.zh: 永熙中，贈平東將軍、齊州刺史。

translations.literal: In the Yongxi era he was posthumously awarded General Who Pacifies the East and Inspector of Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongxi era he was posthumously awarded General Who Pacifies the East and Inspector of Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 潘永基，字紹業，長樂廣宗人也。

translations.literal: Pan Yongji, styled Shaoye, was a native of Guangzong in Langle.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Yongji, styled Shaoye, was a native of Guangzong in Langle.

sentences.zh: 父靈虬，中書侍郎。

translations.literal: His father Lingqiu served as Attendant Gentleman in the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: His father Lingqiu served as Attendant Gentleman in the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 永基性通率，輕財好施。

translations.literal: Yongji was by nature straightforward and generous, lightly valued wealth and loved to give.
translations.idiomatic: Yongji was by nature straightforward and generous, lightly valued wealth and loved to give.

sentences.zh: 為冀州鎮東府法曹行參軍，遷威烈將軍、揚州曲陽戍主，轉西硤石戍主，治陳留、南梁二郡事，頗有威惠。

translations.literal: He served as Acting Staff Officer in the Law Bureau of the Eastern Headquarters of Jizhou, was transferred to General of Majestic Ferocity and Commandant of the Quyang Garrison, then transferred to Commandant of the Xixia Garrison, administering the affairs of Chenliu and Nanliang commanderies; he had considerable authority and kindness.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Acting Staff Officer in the Law Bureau of the Eastern Headquarters of Jizhou, was transferred to General of Majestic Ferocity and Commandant of the Quyang Garrison, then transferred to Commandant of the Xixia Garrison, administering the affairs of Chenliu and Nanliang commanderies; he had considerable authority and kindness.

sentences.zh: 轉揚州車騎府主簿。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Chief Clerk in the Chariots and Cavalry Headquarters of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Chief Clerk in the Chariots and Cavalry Headquarters of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 累遷虎賁中郎將、直寢、前將軍。

translations.literal: He was promoted successively to Tiger Guard Commandant of the Palace, Direct Attendant, and General of the Vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted successively to Tiger Guard Commandant of the Palace, Direct Attendant, and General of the Vanguard.

sentences.zh: 出為持節、平北將軍、冀州防城都督、長樂太守。

translations.literal: He went out with the staff of authority as General Who Pacifies the North, Area Commander for the Defense of Jizhou, and Administrator of Langle.
translations.idiomatic: He went out with the staff of authority as General Who Pacifies the North, Area Commander for the Defense of Jizhou, and Administrator of Langle.

sentences.zh: 于時葛榮攻信都，長圍遏水以灌州城。

translations.literal: At that time Ge Rong attacked Xindu and for a long siege blocked the waters to flood the walled city.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Ge Rong attacked Xindu and for a long siege blocked the waters to flood the walled city.

sentences.zh: 永基與刺史元孚同心勠力，晝夜防拒。

translations.literal: Yongji and Inspector Yuan Fu united their hearts and strength, defending day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Yongji and Inspector Yuan Fu united their hearts and strength, defending day and night.

sentences.zh: 外無軍援，內乏糧儲，從春至冬，力窮乃陷。

translations.literal: Outside there was no military relief; inside provisions were exhausted; from spring to winter, when strength was spent, the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: Outside there was no military relief; inside provisions were exhausted; from spring to winter, when strength was spent, the city fell.

sentences.zh: 榮欲害孚，永基請以身代孚死。

translations.literal: Rong wished to kill Fu; Yongji requested to die in Fu's place.
translations.idiomatic: Rong wished to kill Fu; Yongji requested to die in Fu's place.

sentences.zh: 永安二年，除潁川太守，遷鎮東將軍、東徐州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongan he was appointed Administrator of Yingchuan, transferred to General Who Conquers the East and Inspector of Eastern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongan he was appointed Administrator of Yingchuan, transferred to General Who Conquers the East and Inspector of Eastern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 時蕭衍將曹世宗、馬洪武等率眾來寇，永基出討，破之。

translations.literal: At that time Xiao Yan's generals Cao Shizong and Ma Hongwu led troops to raid; Yongji went out to attack and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiao Yan's generals Cao Shizong and Ma Hongwu led troops to raid; Yongji went out to attack and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 永熙中，為征東將軍、金紫光祿大夫，遷車騎將軍、左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the Yongxi era he served as General Who Conquers the East and Grand Master of the Palace with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, transferred to General of Chariots and Cavalry and Grand Master of the Palace with Left Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongxi era he served as General Who Conquers the East and Grand Master of the Palace with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, transferred to General of Chariots and Cavalry and Grand Master of the Palace with Left Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 尋加衞大將軍，復除東徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was additionally appointed Grand General of the Guard and again appointed Inspector of Eastern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was additionally appointed Grand General of the Guard and again appointed Inspector of Eastern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 前後在州，為吏民所樂。

translations.literal: In successive terms in the province, officials and commoners were pleased with him.
translations.idiomatic: In successive terms in the province, officials and commoners were pleased with him.

sentences.zh: 代還京師，元象初卒，年五十六。

translations.literal: On returning to the capital after his replacement, he died at the beginning of the Yuanxiang era at the age of fifty-six.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the capital after his replacement, he died at the beginning of the Yuanxiang era at the age of fifty-six.

sentences.zh: 贈散騎常侍、都督冀瀛滄三州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、尚書右僕射、司徒公、冀州刺史。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Regular Attendant of the Secretariat, Area Commander-in-Chief over Ji, Ying, and Cang provinces, General of Agile Cavalry, Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Duke of the Secretariat, and Inspector of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded Regular Attendant of the Secretariat, Area Commander-in-Chief over Ji, Ying, and Cang provinces, General of Agile Cavalry, Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Duke of the Secretariat, and Inspector of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 長子子禮，州主簿。

translations.literal: His eldest son Zili served as Chief Clerk of the province.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Zili served as Chief Clerk of the province.

sentences.zh: 子禮弟子智，武定中，太尉士曹參軍。

translations.literal: Zili's younger brother's son Zhi, during the Wuding era, served as Staff Officer in the Ministry of Works of the Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Zili's younger brother's son Zhi, during the Wuding era, served as Staff Officer in the Ministry of Works of the Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 朱元旭，字君昇，本樂陵人也。

translations.literal: Zhu Yuanxu, styled Junsheng, was originally from Leling.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yuanxu, styled Junsheng, was originally from Leling.

translations.literal: His grandfather Ba, [7] at the end of the Zhenjun era rebelled southward, fled to Liu Yilong, and settled in Leling in Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Ba, [7] at the end of the Zhenjun era rebelled southward, fled to Liu Yilong, and settled in Leling in Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 元旭頗涉子史，開解几案。

translations.literal: Yuanxu read widely in the histories and was quick to understand documents.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxu read widely in the histories and was quick to understand documents.

sentences.zh: 起家清河王國常侍。

translations.literal: He began his career as Regular Attendant of the Prince of Qinghe's kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: He began his career as Regular Attendant of the Prince of Qinghe's kingdom.

sentences.zh: 太學博士、員外散騎侍郎。

translations.literal: Erudite of the Imperial University and Supernumerary Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Erudite of the Imperial University and Supernumerary Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 頻使高麗。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly sent to Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly sent to Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 除尚書度支郎中。

translations.literal: He was appointed Gentleman in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Gentleman in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 神龜末，以郎選不精，大加沙汰。

translations.literal: Near the end of the Shengui era, because the selection of Gentlemen was not refined, a great purge was carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Shengui era, because the selection of Gentlemen was not refined, a great purge was carried out.

sentences.zh: 元旭與隴西辛雄、范陽祖瑩、泰山羊深、西平源子恭並以才用見留。

translations.literal: Yuanxu, together with Xin Xiong of Longxi, Zu Ying of Fanyang, Yang Shen of Mount Tai, and Yuan Zigong of Xiping, were all retained for their talent and ability.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxu, together with Xin Xiong of Longxi, Zu Ying of Fanyang, Yang Shen of Mount Tai, and Yuan Zigong of Xiping, were all retained for their talent and ability.

sentences.zh: 尋加鎮遠將軍、兼尚書右丞，仍郎中、本州中正。

translations.literal: Soon he was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the Distance and concurrently Vice Director of the Right in the Ministry of Works, still serving as Gentleman and Chief Rectifier of his home province.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the Distance and concurrently Vice Director of the Right in the Ministry of Works, still serving as Gentleman and Chief Rectifier of his home province.

sentences.zh: 時關西都督蕭寶夤啟云：「所統十萬，食唯一月。

translations.literal: At that time Area Commander of Guanxi Xiao Baoyin reported: "The troops under my command number one hundred thousand; provisions suffice for only one month."
translations.idiomatic: At that time Area Commander of Guanxi Xiao Baoyin reported: "The troops under my command number one hundred thousand; provisions suffice for only one month."

sentences.zh: 」於是肅宗大怒，召問所由。

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong thereupon was greatly angered and summoned officials to inquire into the cause.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaoming thereupon was greatly angered and summoned officials to inquire into the cause.

sentences.zh: 錄、令以下，皆推罪於元旭。

translations.literal: From the Recorder and Vice Director downward, all shifted blame onto Yuanxu.
translations.idiomatic: From the Recorder and Vice Director downward, all shifted blame onto Yuanxu.

sentences.zh: 元旭入見，於御座前屈指校計寶夤兵糧乃踰一年，事乃得釋。

translations.literal: Yuanxu entered audience and, before the imperial seat, counted on his fingers and calculated that Baoyin's army provisions would last more than a year; the matter was then cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxu entered audience and, before the imperial seat, counted on his fingers and calculated that Baoyin's army provisions would last more than a year; the matter was then cleared.

sentences.zh: 除通直散騎常侍。

translations.literal: He was appointed Regular Attendant of the Secretariat Through Direct Communications.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Regular Attendant of the Secretariat Through Direct Communications.

sentences.zh: 永安初，加平東將軍、尚書左丞、光祿大夫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongan he was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the East, Vice Director of the Left in the Ministry of Works, and Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongan he was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the East, Vice Director of the Left in the Ministry of Works, and Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 後轉司農少卿。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries.

sentences.zh: 遷衞將軍、左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to General of the Guard and Grand Master of the Palace with Left Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to General of the Guard and Grand Master of the Palace with Left Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 天平中，復拜尚書左丞。

translations.literal: In the Tianping era he was again appointed Vice Director of the Left in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianping era he was again appointed Vice Director of the Left in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 既無風操，俛仰隨俗，性多機數，自容而已。

translations.literal: He had no moral integrity and bowed to the prevailing ways; by nature he was full of schemes and merely preserved himself.
translations.idiomatic: He had no moral integrity and bowed to the prevailing ways; by nature he was full of schemes and merely preserved himself.

sentences.zh: 於時朝廷分汲郡、河內二界挾河之地以立義州，安置關西歸款之戶，除元旭使持節、驃騎將軍、義州刺史。

translations.literal: At that time the court carved out the lands straddling the river from the borders of Ji and Henei commanderies to establish Yizhou, settling households from Guanxi who had submitted; Yuanxu was appointed Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General of Agile Cavalry, and Inspector of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the court carved out the lands straddling the river from the borders of Ji and Henei commanderies to establish Yizhou, settling households from Guanxi who had submitted; Yuanxu was appointed Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General of Agile Cavalry, and Inspector of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 武定三年夏，卒於州，年六十七。

translations.literal: In the summer of the third year of Wuding he died in the province at the age of sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the third year of Wuding he died in the province at the age of sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 贈本將軍、幽州刺史。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded his former rank of general and Inspector of Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded his former rank of general and Inspector of Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 子敬道，武定中，司徒長流參軍。

translations.literal: His son Jingdao, during the Wuding era, served as Senior Staff Officer in the Secretariat of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jingdao, during the Wuding era, served as Senior Staff Officer in the Secretariat of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：陽尼學義之迹，世不乏人。

translations.literal: The historian says: The traces of Yang Ni's learning and righteousness— the age has never lacked such men.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: The traces of Yang Ni's learning and righteousness— the age has never lacked such men.

sentences.zh: 固遠氣正情，文學兼致。

translations.literal: Gu had far-reaching spirit and upright feeling, combining literary and scholarly attainment.
translations.idiomatic: Gu had far-reaching spirit and upright feeling, combining literary and scholarly attainment.

sentences.zh: 賈思伯門有舊業，經明行修，唯兄及弟，並標儒素。

translations.literal: Jia Sibo's family had an old tradition; clear in the classics and cultivated in conduct, he and his brother alike were marked by Confucian plainness.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sibo's family had an old tradition; clear in the classics and cultivated in conduct, he and his brother alike were marked by Confucian plainness.

sentences.zh: 李、路器尚所及，俱可觀者。

translations.literal: Li and Lu reached the level of capacity and integrity— both are worth viewing.
translations.idiomatic: Li and Lu reached the level of capacity and integrity— both are worth viewing.

sentences.zh: 象風彩詞涉，亦當年之俊民。

translations.literal: Xiang's bearing, style, and literary range also made him a outstanding man of his day.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang's bearing, style, and literary range also made him an outstanding man of his day.

sentences.zh: 房亮、曹世表、潘永基、朱元旭，拔萃從宦，咸享名器，各有由也。

translations.literal: Fang Liang, Cao Shibiao, Pan Yongji, and Zhu Yuanxu, rising above the common run in official service, all enjoyed famous offices— each for his own reasons.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Liang, Cao Shibiao, Pan Yongji, and Zhu Yuanxu, rising above the common run in official service, all enjoyed famous offices— each for his own reasons.
